profile.businessSummary: V-Guard is a trusted name in the Indian consumer goods industry, evolving since its start in 1977 to build a diversified presence. The company's core philosophy is that the vision it holds for the future directly shapes the actions it takes today for continuous growth. Its journey began with a simple belief that quality, reliability, and relevance could power not just homes but also progress. A key strength is blending engineering precision with practical design to deliver products that solve real needs in everyday life. It has constantly evolved with a changing India by staying in step with consumer expectations and expanding into new categories and technologies. This growth has resulted in a vast retail presence spanning over 1,00,000 outlets and a growing connection with digital-first consumers.

news.title: V Guard plans 2–3% price hikes, Rs 150 crore FY27 capex, and solar expansion into North and East India. The company targets 21–22% non-wire revenue from new products, despite input cost volatility and rooftop solar competition.

V-Guard shares surged up to 11% after Q2 consolidated net profit jumped 72.3% YoY to ₹112 crore. Revenue rose 38.2% YoY to ₹1,853 crore, driven by strong growth across Electricals, Electronics, and Consumer Durables segments.
V-Guard Industries reported a sharp 72% growth in profit for the second quarter. Following the Q2 results, the stock saw a strong recovery, surging 16% from lower levels.

V-Guard Industries approved Kurian Puthenpuraiyil John as Additional Independent Director for five years, subject to shareholder approval. The board also approved unaudited Q2/H1 results and allotted 1,63,183 shares to 36 employees under ESOS 2013.

V-Guard Q2 consolidated net profit rose to ₹111.7 crore from ₹65.3 crore YoY, while revenue climbed to ₹1,852.9 crore. The board approved appointing Kurian Puthenpurayil John as Independent Director and allotted 1,63,183 equity shares under ESOP.
V-Guard reported Q2 EBITDA of ₹1.7B, increasing from ₹1.1B YoY. Q2 EBITDA margin expanded to 9.1% compared to 8.2% YoY.

V-Guard Industries approved granting 16,747 employee stock options under ESOS 2013 at an exercise price of ₹1 each. The options vest over one to four years and are exercisable within six years from the vesting date.

V-Guard Industries' board will meet on October 29, 2026, to approve Q2 and half-year financial results. The trading window for dealing in company securities remains closed until 48 hours after results announcement.
V-Guard's Chairperson Radha Unni to retire on Sep 26, 2026, ending her second term. Mithun K Chittilappilly to assume Chairperson role from Sep 27, 2026; he is currently the MD.
V-Guard Industries Ltd will attend Axis Capital Consumer & Tech Conference 2026 in Mumbai. The meeting is scheduled for Sep 10, 2026, at 10:00 AM IST as per SEBI compliance.
